title: The New York Stock Exchange Welcomes Redwire to Ring Opening Bell, Celebrating Five Years of Transformation and Global Expansion

body_markdown:
On September 1, Redwire Chairman and CEO Peter Cannito, alongside members of the executive leadership team, rang the opening bell at the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE). The bell-ringing ceremony commemorated Redwire’s fifth year as a publicly traded company, highlighting Redwire’s exciting expansion from a pure-play space infrastructure company to an agile, multi-domain space and defense tech powerhouse that is enabling the most critical missions for U.S. and global customers.


On September 1, 2026, the New York Stock Exchange welcomed Redwire to celebrate its 5th anniversary of listing. Credit: NYSE


Over five years, Redwire has strengthened its market position through strategic expansion into higher value programs and broader portfolio capabilities. As Redwire expanded its business, the company has more than doubled its employee base, more than tripled its global footprint, and completed four strategic acquisitions.


Redwire’s Chairman and CEO Peter Cannito and Chief Financial Officer Chris Edmunds at the NYSE. On September 1, 2026, the welcomed Redwire to celebrate its 5th anniversary of listing. Credit: NYSE


Redwire’s financial performance has also evolved since 2021. For the most recent quarter, Q2 2026, Redwire achieved record quarterly revenue of $117.1M, record quarterly gross margins of 27.8%, and record backlog of $542.1M.


Redwire’s evolution was made possible by its dedicated team around the world and a relentless focus on delivering mission-critical technology to its customers. Read the latest Redwire news for exciting stories about our mission-ready team in the[Redwire Newsroom](https://rdw.com/newsroom/) .
